functions.name: data_extraction_function
functions.description: Read the IDAT files and sample sheet of a node into a long table of Beta and M values per probe and sample, with the cohort of each sample. Quality control and normalisation (pylluminator, SeSAMe-style, within each sample): pOOBAH detection p-values (probes above the threshold masked), masking of quality, control, non-CpG, SNP and X/Y-chromosome probes, optionally inference of the colour channel of type I probes, non-linear dye-bias correction and NOOB background correction. Probes missing in any sample of the hospital are left out. No between-sample (e.g. BMIQ, quantile) or batch normalisation. The task log of each hospital has a QC summary: probes masked and left out, the share of failed probes per sample, and samples above the flag threshold (flagged, not removed).

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Column in the sample sheet that holds the cohort of each sample (case-insensitive, e.g. 'Cohort').

arguments.name: sample_sheet_name
arguments.description: File name of the sample sheet in the IDAT folder. By default samplesheet.csv or sample_sheet.csv is used.

arguments.name: sample_columns
arguments.description: Other sample sheet columns to add to every row, e.g. Site. Column names become snake_case (Age at menopause -> age_at_menopause). An Age column is added automatically if the sample sheet has one (needed for the epigenetic clocks' age acceleration).

arguments.name: pvalue_threshold
arguments.description: pOOBAH detection p-value above which a probe is masked.

arguments.name: min_beads
arguments.description: Probes measured with fewer beads are masked.

arguments.name: qc_flag_fraction
arguments.display_name: QC flag: share of failed probes
arguments.description: Samples with more than this share of probes failing detection are flagged in the task log (they are kept). 0.1 = 10%, as ChAMP's sample cut-off.

arguments.name: infer_type1_channel
arguments.display_name: Infer the colour channel of type I probes
arguments.description: SeSAMe's recommended step for EPIC: set each type I probe's channel to the one with the higher signal, before the other steps. Off by default (the earlier results were computed without it).

functions.display_name: Extract Beta and M values from IDATs
